question: In September 2022, the _____________ Assembly sets aside one day for women MLAs to speak about women issues such as safety, health, hygiene and education.
solution:
The correct answer is **Uttar Pradesh**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Uttar Pradesh** Assembly reserved a day in September 2022 for women MLAs to discuss issues related to women.
 
• This initiative was aimed at addressing crucial topics such as **safety, health, hygiene, and education** of women.
 
• It provided a platform for women MLAs to voice their concerns and contribute to policy-making.
 
• This move was widely appreciated as a step towards gender inclusivity in the legislative process.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Topic
 Description
 
 
 
 

 **Women Safety**
 Measures and policies to protect women from violence and harassment.
 
 

 **Health**
 Initiatives aimed at improving the overall health and well-being of women.
 
 

 **Hygiene**
 Programs focused on menstrual hygiene and sanitation for women.
 
 

 **Education**
 Efforts to enhance educational opportunities and literacy rates among women.
